periods.label: Gargoyle-type Abyss attackers
periods.affiliation: abyss-creatures; controlled temporarily by abyss-flute users

status.alive: multiple individuals; several destroyed in volume 1
status.condition: first specimen destroyed by Lisha and Lux; later swarm defeated by Lux

appearance.overview: black metallic winged humanoid monster with claws and feather-like light projectile attacks

personality.summary: hostile predator with enough intelligence to feint attacks and exploit protective instincts

mannerisms: targets crowds or feints toward them

birth.place: ruins or large slime Abyss hatching

background.upbringing: Abyss creature; some are hatched from the large slime Abyss under flute control
background.pre_story: Abyss are known as humanity's natural enemies

lux-arcadia.summary: Lux intercepts and baits Gargoyles to protect others

lisha-atismata.summary: Lisha destroys the first Gargoyle with Seven Dragon Heads

belbet-balt.summary: Belbet hatches and directs a Gargoyle swarm using the flute

periods.summary: Gargoyle Abyss are black metallic winged monsters. One attacks the academy duel and is destroyed by Lux and Lisha; later Belbet hatches a swarm from the large Abyss to trap Lisha and threaten Crossfield.

key_events.summary: A single Gargoyle attacks the academy arena and is destroyed through Lux and Lisha's cooperation.
A swarm of roughly thirty Gargoyles hatches from the large Abyss under Belbet's flute control.
